freshness: Version, assessment, event, and evidence dates are ordered. Event evidence may not postdate the event and is treated as current for at most 365 days. Materiality and propagation remain versioned heuristics.
performanceTarget: Immediate exact-value diff and all-simple-path traversal for the synthetic four-node acyclic fixture.
fallback: Before/after values, evidence, noncausal impact bases, all registered paths, and replay metadata remain readable without animation.
certificationBoundary: Authenticated live-browser, physical-device accessibility, GitHub-hosted CI, and LinkedIn platform QA remain independent.
